name: C.R.A.B.S. - Chesapeake Real Ale Brewers Society
description: C.R.A.B.S. is a homebrewing club that has been meeting regularly since 1981. We brew (and sample) anything from hop drenched pale ales, face puckering sours to the most delicate meads. Our friendly competitions get you feedback on your creations. Meet us at our next meeting and bring your homebrew or favorite commercial brew inspirations.
